title: De Morgan dual of a CNF computes its negation
statement: Let $\psi$ be a formula in conjunctive normal form over $n$ Boolean variables — a conjunction of clauses, each clause a disjunction of literals — and let its De Morgan dual DNF be obtained by negating every literal of $\psi$, so that each clause $\bigvee_j l_{ij}$ becomes the term $\bigwedge_j \lnot l_{ij}$. Then for every assignment $x \colon \{0,\dots,n-1\} \to \{\mathrm{true},\mathrm{false}\}$, evaluating this dual DNF at $x$ yields exactly the negation of the value of $\psi$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: CNF formula ψ over n variables
Boolean assignment x on the n variables
